source.note: static/openapi.json in github.com/ideal-postcodes/postcodes.io, served at api.postcodes.io/openapi.json. It leaves out 3 documented routes and 8 documented parameters, which evals/extraction/additions/postcodes_io.json adds. Replaces REST Countries, whose v3.1 URLs now redirect and whose v5 API needs a key (checked 2026-11-24). Plus 3 routes and 8 parameters added by hand (marked with a note): the official OpenAPI file leaves out routes and parameters that the postcodes.io docs pages document and the server serves (approved 2026-11-24). Served but undocumented routes (/postcodes/{postcode}/validate, /postcodes/lon/{lon}/lat/{lat}) are not added.
